body:
Both PRs are pushed and ready for the independent STRICT review.
- aida#2834 head f9ec63124d (STORY-1706). It has your 12:55 ruling: A1 and A2 as approved, and record spec= as the fallback when relay.status names no spec (exact PREFIX-N, known to the store; absent, malformed or unknown is refused). Tests for both.
  CI reds from 0373952fc2: the golden help snapshot is regenerated, the /tmp fixture literal is replaced, and the relay flags in docs/cli/04-git-lifecycle.md are reworded (verify-manual attributed them to aida mandate). Locally, check-ci-fast then caught the executable-fixture ratchet, now fixed with the test_exec helpers. Two items in your 14:37 mail were not real failures: the gates job's shard and classifier "errors" are fixture output from the gate scripts' own self-tests (the real red was the portability ratchet), and the contracts job's "Draft to Completed" line is printed by a step that passes (the real red was verify-manual flags).
  Gates at the final tree: make check-ci-fast passes 34/34 (fast tier); make test-touched passes 405/0/1 ignored, run before the last test-only commit; story_1706 passes 28/28 after it.
- aida-relay#97 head c2104bf (Refs STORY-1706): --spec and the profile spec key write spec= in relay.launch (a malformed id exits 1 before the run starts, and --spec is kept in the resume argv), plus a --prompt-file resume test. Local: story1706 shell 10/10, story91 profiles passes, cargo test profile passes. story109 never started locally (cargo-slot wait); CI's shell job covers it.
I have not shipped, merged, approved or cleared anything. #2834 goes to the operator after STRICT review (C4).
subject: STORY-1706 pushed: aida#2834 @f9ec63124d, aida-relay#97 @c2104bf (ruling 12:55 done, CI fixes)
